name: Asking In Prayer
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are encouraged to ask God in prayer with confident faith, assured that He will respond. Jesus promises that those who ask, seek, and knock will receive, find, and have doors opened to them, especially when requests are made in His name to glorify the Father. Prayer must be accompanied by unwavering faith, as doubt hinders the effectiveness of asking. Through prayer grounded in belief and in Jesus' name, believers can experience the fullness of joy and receive what they desire according to God's will.
